name: Eastern Province Cement Company
summary: Eastern Province Cement Company produces and sells clinker and cement products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It operates through two segments, Cement and Precast. The company offers ordinary Portland, sulphate-resisting, finishing, ordinary, salt-resistant, and clinker cement products. It also provides partitions, frames, and prefabricated buildings made from prefabricated concrete. In addition, the company engages in the operation of quarries; mining of gypsum and anhydrite; and wholesale of cement and gypsum.
